 The Constitution Of India Praying To Quashing /
 Setting Aside The Impugned Order

PASSED IN L.A.C. NO.
 36/2015 DATED 02/12/2019, BY THE HONBLE SENIOR CIVIL  JUDGE AND JMFC AT KUNIGAL, AT ANN-A BY FIXING THE  PREVAILING MARKET VALUE OF THE PETITIONERS PROPERTY  WAS VALUED MORE THAN RS. 50,000/- GUNTA.
 -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:5410  WP No. 35508 of 2024  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.G.S. KAMAL  ORAL ORDER Petitioners are before this Court being aggrieved by the order dated 02.12.2019 passed in LAC No.36/2015 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, JMFC, Kunigal under Section 18(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 seeking following reliefs;
"a. Issue a writ in the nature of Certiorari or any other appropriate writ, quashing /setting-aside the impugned order passed in LAC No.36/2015 dated 02.12.2019 by the Hon'ble Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Kunigal at Annexure-A by fixing the prevailing market value of the petitioner's property was valued more than Rs.50,000/- gunta."
2.

The petition essentially seeking enhancement of compensation awarded by the respondent No.1-SLAO and re- determined by LAC Court as above which is required to be adjudicated as provided under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
At this juncture counsel for the petitioners seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the petition and pursue the remedy as provided thereunder.
In view of the above, petition is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty as sought for.

SD/-
(M.G.S. KAMAL) JUDGE PK CT: BHK Sri Doddathopegowda vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137902528/
